faq.a: Lou's is a cafe listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of them. Rockstar has not named them in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Lou's as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names them.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Lou's?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Place type: cafe. Scope: single site. Coordinates: not given. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Lou's information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Lou's, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Lou's?
faq.a: Most of it. Lou's rest on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Where it sits on the map and whether the player can go inside are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Lou's be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of landmark entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
